## Optimizing WBG Application Performance


Wide bandgap (WBG) devices like SiC and GaN promise major gains in efficiency and power consumption, but a single datasheet operating point can’t show how they behave under real high-frequency, high-temperature conditions. Optimizing an application on that limited information is a real design risk.


In this Silvaco webinar, we’ll look at why standard datasheets and physical measurements fall short for WBG application design, and what additional device information is needed to optimize performance across varying real-world mission profiles.


**Why attend:**


- Understand the challenges of using WBG devices in power supply design
- See why datasheets don’t contain enough information to accurately optimize your design
- Learn what additional device information is required for the best optimization


Speaker: Britt Brooks, Power Applications Engineer, Silvaco. Britt brings 4 years at Wolfspeed modeling SiC power devices and 30 years at Texas Instruments in product engineering and SPICE modeling, and he chaired the Compact Model Council (now Coalition) for 7 years.


**Who Should Attend:**


Intended for power device engineers (R&D and product), power application engineers, power system engineers, and managers responsible for power engineering and applications.
